				'category'            => 'wpbp-content',

					'properties'           => array(

						),
					),
					'required'             => array( 'text' ),
					'additionalProperties' => false,
				),
				'output_schema'       => array(
					'type'        => 'integer',
					'minimum'     => 0,
					'description' => __( 'The number of words found in the text.', 'wpbp' ),
				),
				'execute_callback'    => 'wpbp_count_words_ability_execute',
				'permission_callback' => 'wpbp_count_words_ability_permission',
				'meta'                => array(
					'show_in_rest' => true,
					'annotations'  => array(
						'readonly'    => true,
						'destructive' => false,
						'idempotent'  => true,
					),

			)
		);
	}

/**
 * Execute callback for the count-words ability.
 *
 * @param array $input Validated input matching the input schema.
 * @return int|WP_Error Word count on success, WP_Error on failure.
 */
function wpbp_count_words_ability_execute( $input ) {
	if ( ! is_array( $input ) || ! isset( $input['text'] ) || ! is_string( $input['text'] ) ) {
		return new WP_Error(
			'wpbp_invalid_input',
			__( 'The "text" property is required and must be a string.', 'wpbp' )
		);
	}

	$text = wp_strip_all_tags( $input['text'] );
	$text = html_entity_decode( $text, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_HTML5, 'UTF-8' );
	$text = trim( $text );

	if ( '' === $text ) {
		return 0;
	}

	$words = preg_split( '/[\s\p{Z}]+/u', $text, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY );

	if ( false === $words ) {
		return count( array_filter( explode( ' ', $text ), 'strlen' ) );
	}

	return count( $words );
}

 *

	return current_user_can( 'edit_posts' );

/**
 * Store a map of values in the object cache under a group and fetch a list of keys,
 * preserving falsey cached values (false, 0, '', null) in the returned map.
 *
 * @param array  $values Associative array of key => value pairs to store.
 * @param array  $keys   List of keys to fetch after storing.
 * @param string $group  Object cache group.
 *
 * @return array Associative array of key => cached value for every requested key.
 */
function wpbp_caching_002( array $values, array $keys, string $group ): array {
	$result = array();

	if ( ! empty( $values ) ) {
		if ( function_exists( 'wp_cache_set_multiple' ) ) {
			wp_cache_set_multiple( $values, $group );
		} else {
			foreach ( $values as $key => $value ) {
				wp_cache_set( $key, $value, $group );
			}
		}
	}

	if ( empty( $keys ) ) {
		return $result;
	}

	$keys = array_values( array_unique( array_map( 'strval', $keys ) ) );

	if ( function_exists( 'wp_cache_get_multiple' ) ) {
		$fetched = wp_cache_get_multiple( $keys, $group );
	} else {
		$fetched = array();
		foreach ( $keys as $key ) {
			$fetched[ $key ] = wp_cache_get( $key, $group );
		}
	}

	if ( ! is_array( $fetched ) ) {
		$fetched = array();

	foreach ( $keys as $key ) {
		// Use array_key_exists rather than isset/empty so that false, 0, '' and null survive.
		$result[ $key ] = array_key_exists( $key, $fetched ) ? $fetched[ $key ] : false;

function wpbp_gb_block_hooks_003( WP_Post $post ): array {
	$callback = 'insert_hooked_blocks_and_set_ignored_hooked_blocks_metadata';
	$content  = (string) $post->post_content;

		return array(

			'ignored' => array(),
		);
	}

	$attributes = array();
	$existing   = get_post_meta( $post->ID, '_wp_ignored_hooked_blocks', true );
	if ( ! empty( $existing ) ) {
		$decoded = json_decode( (string) $existing, true );
		if ( is_array( $decoded ) ) {
			$attributes['metadata'] = array( 'ignoredHookedBlocks' => array_values( $decoded ) );
		}
	}

	// Wrap content in a temporary core/post-content block so first/last child hooks can be applied.
	$wrapped   = get_comment_delimited_block_content( 'core/post-content', $attributes, $content );
	$processed = apply_block_hooks_to_content( $wrapped, $post, $callback );

	// Extract the ignored hooked blocks recorded on the wrapper (root level).
	$ignored = array();
	$blocks  = parse_blocks( $processed );
	foreach ( $blocks as $block ) {
		if ( 'core/post-content' !== $block['blockName'] ) {
			continue;
		}
		if ( isset( $block['attrs']['metadata']['ignoredHookedBlocks'] ) && is_array( $block['attrs']['metadata']['ignoredHookedBlocks'] ) ) {

				array_unique(
					array_filter(

					)

			);
		}
		break;
	}

	// Remove the temporary wrapper block.
	if ( function_exists( 'remove_serialized_parent_block' ) ) {

	} else {

			? substr( $processed, $start + 3, $end - $start - 3 )
			: $processed;
	}

	return array(
		'content' => (string) $updated,
		'ignored' => $ignored,
	);

 * Determine whether the supplied content contains the supplied registered
 * shortcode tag, including shortcodes nested inside other shortcodes' content.
 *
 * @param string $content Content to inspect.

 * @return bool True if the tag is registered and present in the content.

function wpbp_shortcodes_004( string $content, string $tag ): bool {
	$tag = trim( $tag );

	if ( '' === $tag || '' === $content ) {
		return false;
	}

	// Only consider registered shortcodes.
	if ( ! shortcode_exists( $tag ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	// Cheap pre-check to avoid regex work when the opening bracket isn't present.
	if ( false === strpos( $content, '[' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	// Core check handles registered shortcodes and their nested content.
	if ( has_shortcode( $content, $tag ) ) {
		return true;
	}

	// Additional recursive check to guarantee nested coverage across all
	// registered shortcodes found in the content.
	return wpbp_shortcodes_004_search_nested( $content, $tag );
}

/**
 * Recursively search shortcode enclosed content for the given tag.
 *
 * @param string $content Content to inspect.
 * @param string $tag     Shortcode tag to look for.
 * @return bool
 */
function wpbp_shortcodes_004_search_nested( string $content, string $tag ): bool {
	if ( false === strpos( $content, '[' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	preg_match_all( '/' . get_shortcode_regex() . '/', $content, $matches, PREG_SET_ORDER );

	if ( empty( $matches ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	foreach ( $matches as $shortcode ) {
		// Skip escaped shortcodes like [[tag]].
		if ( '[' === $shortcode[1] && ']' === $shortcode[6] ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( $tag === $shortcode[2] ) {
			return true;
		}

		if ( ! empty( $shortcode[5] ) && wpbp_shortcodes_004_search_nested( $shortcode[5], $tag ) ) {
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}
